headline: This law authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal for hockey figure Willie O'Ree, or a family member if he is unavailable, to recognize his work in hockey, inclusion, and recreation.
what_it_does: The law provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to Willie O'Ree. If he is unavailable, the medal may go to a member of his family. Money from selling duplicate medals goes into the U.S. Mint Public Enterprise Fund.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 31, 2022.
